_readme: LISTING STATUS OVERRIDES for property-lookup.html.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS:
There is no free public API that reports whether a New Jersey home is
currently for sale. MLS status lives behind Bright MLS / IDX, which is a
licensed feed. Zillow and Realtor.com have no open API and their terms
prohibit scraping. So the page cannot detect 'For Sale' on its own.
What it CAN do without help:
- read the recorded deed date from MOD-IV and show 'Recently sold' when
the transfer is inside the last 12 months
- otherwise show 'Off market', which is what the public record supports
This file is the override. Anything you list here wins over the automatic
status. Use it for your own listings, your team's listings, coming soons,
and anything you know about firsthand. When you get an IDX feed, swap the
resolveStatus() function in the page and this file becomes optional.
KEYS:
Preferred: the PAMS_PIN shown in every lookup result under 'State parcel ID'.
Also accepted: the full property address in caps, exactly as PROP_LOC shows it.
STATUS VALUES (anything else is shown as typed):
For sale | Coming soon | Under contract | Just sold | For sale by owner | For rent
OPTIONAL FIELDS: price, mls, agent ('john' or 'heather'), url, date, note
